description: Source provenance for the 10 primary examples/eval/ documents used by scripts/run_10_evals.py and bench/run_benchmark.py. sha256/bytes reflect the files as currently checked in; re-run scripts/download_public_eval_datasets.py to refresh live sources (content may drift upstream).
